verdict.rationale: SharePoint documents remote, non-UI programmatic access through its REST service and Microsoft Graph, including CRUD, batching and Entra ID authentication for external applications. A headless script or CI job could drive the product this way. However, the evidence shows no CI-oriented tooling, CLI, or documented non-interactive service-principal flow for pipelines. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline integration, explicit app-only/non-interactive auth guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
